description:
Set the log streaming configuration for a specific log type. Configures where logs are sent (e.g. Axiom, Datadog, Splunk, Elasticsearch, S3).

Per-destination required fields:
- splunk / elastic / panther / cribl / datadog / axiom: url + token (user optional)
- s3: s3Bucket + s3Region + s3AuthenticationType, plus either (s3AccessKeyId + s3SecretAccessKey) for 'accesskey' auth or s3RoleArn for 'rolearn' auth. Call tailscale_create_aws_external_id first when using 'rolearn'.

compressionFormat.description: Compression algorithm for log uploads. Defaults to 'none'.

logType.description: The log type: 'configuration' for audit logs, 'network' for network flow logs

s3AccessKeyId.description: (s3 only) AWS access key id. Required when s3AuthenticationType is 'accesskey'.

s3AuthenticationType.description: (s3 only) Authentication mode. Required when destinationType is 's3'. Tailscale recommends 'rolearn'.

s3Bucket.description: (s3 only) S3 bucket name. Required when destinationType is 's3'.

s3KeyPrefix.description: (s3 only) Optional prefix prepended to the auto-generated S3 object key.

s3Region.description: (s3 only) AWS region of the S3 bucket. Required when destinationType is 's3'.

s3RoleArn.description: (s3 only) IAM role ARN that Tailscale will assume. Required when s3AuthenticationType is 'rolearn'.

s3SecretAccessKey.description: (s3 only) AWS secret access key. Required when s3AuthenticationType is 'accesskey'. SENSITIVE: see the token field's note about MCP client logging.

token.description: Authentication token or API key for the destination. SENSITIVE: passed straight to Tailscale and not echoed back, but MCP clients may log the input value you supply.

uploadPeriodMinutes.description: Minutes to wait between uploads (1-1440). Optional.

name: tailscale_set_log_stream_config
title: Set log stream config
